thread:
oncall-bot: Pager: HIGH — 5xx spike from inference-serving (redis write backpressure). Alert: redis.write.throttle.rate > 5/min across us-east-1 replicas. Triggered 23 times in last 12m. Paging: @Maria L (oncall)

Maria L: ack — looking. any customer-facing errors? is this spiking latency too?

oncall-bot: Customer impact: a subset of streaming requests show intermittent truncation (retries observed). Error sample attached: `kv_cache_evict: write_throttle`

Maria L: Thanks. I'm going to do quick triage and mute noisy duplicate pagers while we investigate.

Sam K: ping — noticed retry storms earlier from batch-ingest job hitting a hot keyset? Might correlate.

Maria L: running log query for last 20m: ```logs.query: service:inference AND env:prod AND message:/write_throttle|evict/ | count by host``` spike on redis-pool-3 and redis-pool-7.

Dana Q: I'm toggling a temporary mute on the alert rule to reduce pager churn while we assess. Pls note, mute expires in 30m unless extended.

Maria L: Good call. Live mitigation plan: 1) temp throttle the batch-ingest client (rate limit at app layer), 2) increase redis client backoff in server from 50ms to 200ms, 3) apply alert tuning to collapse duplicate rules. Doing 1 & 2 now.

Raj P: If we change client backoff, watch tail latency. I can stand by to revert if we see regressions.

Maria L: Done — pushed config change to app canary (10%): `INFER_CLIENT_BACKOFF_MS=200` (canary link: https://ci.internal/redeploy/inf-canary/4321). Monitoring traces.

infra-bot: Deploy succeeded on 10% canary in us-east-1 (job 4321). Metrics: redis write errors on canary host reduced ~40% so far.

Sam K: Nice. Looks like hot key contention is main vector — batch job was hammering a small shard. We should add a suppression for noisy retry logs that are expected during backoff changes.

Maria L: Agreed. After stabilization we'll do permanent alert rule updates: (A) raise threshold from 5 -> 10/min and add host-level grouping, (B) add regex to exclude `retry_delay` transient messages, (C) add new signature for `kv_cache_evict` to track persistent failures vs transient backoff.

Maria L: Draft log-based alert update I'm about to push to infra-alerts: ```
# old rule
query: service:inference AND status:5xx AND message:/write_throttle/
threshold: 5

# new rule proposal
query: service:inference AND status:5xx AND message:/write_throttle/ AND NOT message:/retry_delay|backoff_expired/
group_by: [host, region]
threshold: 10
note: exclude known client retry logs and only alert on persistent host-level spikes >10/min for 5m
```

Dana Q: For the regex, add a capture so we can tag events that match `kv_cache_evict` specifically. Suggest: `/kv_cache_evict|kv-evict|cache evict/i` — cover variations.

Sam K: Also create a separate signature `redis_kv_eviction_persistent` for the alerting system so we can track regression history and attach evals.

Maria L: I'll open the PR for infra-alerts with the above changes + a dashboard tile for host-level distribution. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra-alerts/pull/1284 (WIP).

Raj P: Maria — I'm taking the on-call handoff at +30. Summary I will pass to next oncall: canary shows improvement, temporary mute in place, PR open to tune rule and add signature. Key actions: monitor canary, confirm reduction sustained 15m, merge PR and roll out, then unmute.

Maria L: Handing off to @Raj P — full notes: what happened, mitigation, proposed alert changes, PR link, dashboard created (dash: https://dashboards.internal/d/redis-hotkey).

Raj P: ack — taking it. I'll extend the mute to 60m if metrics look stable and coordinate with batch-ingest owners to throttle upstream job permanently.

Dana Q: postmortem items: - add automatic suppression for known transient backoff logs - add runbook step mapping `kv_cache_evict` signature -> mitigation steps - add per-customer impact metric to dashboard (so we can correlate truncated streams)

Maria L: Agree. After merge, we'll schedule a follow-up for alert noise reduction: reduce duplicate pagers by grouping by host and adding suppression windows during deploys.

Raj P: Quick follow-up PR we'll do to the alert rule (post-canary): ```
- switch to host-level cardinality check
- add silence windows for deploys: `meta.deploy=true`
- add tag extraction: `extracted_signature: /kv_cache_evict|kv-evict/`
```
I'll shepherd the PR after canary is green.

infra-bot: Ticket created: INF-4521 — "redis write throttle: alert tuning + signature for kv_cache_evict" assigned to eng-sre.

Sam K: FYI I'll open a small change in batch-ingest to implement exponential jitter and light client-level sharding to avoid hot keys. Link later.

Maria L: Thanks team. I'll update the incident log with timeline and customer impact summary (approx 3% of streaming requests in 12m had truncations, no persistent data loss). Leaving the mute and handoff to Raj.

Raj P: All — if anything noisy pops back, ping me directly. Otherwise will merge PR if canary holds and then we can close INF-4521 with the alert rule rollout notes. :thumbsup:
